data.text/markdown: Exploration 2. Price (Q2, Q3)

outputs.evalue: The variable 'a' was defined by another cell
outputs.code:
bins = [-0.01, 0, 4.99, 9.99, 19.99, 29.99, 59.99, 10_000]
labels = ["Free", "$0.01 to 4.99", "$5 to 9.99", "$10 to 19.99", "$20 to 29.99",
          "$30 to 59.99", "$60+"]
pb = (coh.assign(price_band=pd.cut(coh.price, bins=bins, labels=labels))
      .groupby("price_band", observed=True)
      .agg(games=("app_id", "size"), median_reviews=("total_reviews", "median"),
           zero_share=("has_reviews", lambda s: (1 - s.mean()) * 100))
      .reset_index())
pb["is_free"] = pb.price_band.astype(str) == "Free"
pb["price_band"] = pb.price_band.astype(str)
enc = dict(
    x=alt.X("price_band:N", sort=labels, title=None, axis=alt.Axis(labelAngle=-30)),
    color=alt.Color("is_free:N", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[True, False], range=[ORANGE, BLUE]),
                    legend=None),
    tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("price_band:N", title="Price"), alt.Tooltip("games:Q", format=","),
             alt.Tooltip("median_reviews:Q", title="Median reviews"),
             alt.Tooltip("zero_share:Q", title="% with zero reviews", format=".1f")],
)
bar = dict(cornerRadiusTopLeft=3, cornerRadiusTopRight=3)
a = alt.Chart(pb).mark_bar(**bar).encode(
    y=alt.Y("median_reviews:Q", title="Median reviews per game"), **enc
).properties(width=W, height=H, title="Median reviews per game, by price")
b = alt.Chart(pb).mark_bar(**bar).encode(
    y=alt.Y("zero_share:Q", title="% of games"), **enc
).properties(width=W, height=H, title="Share of games with zero reviews")
mo.ui.altair_chart(a | b)

data.text/markdown: Exploration 3. Genres, crowded vs attention (Q4, Q5)

outputs.evalue: The variable 'pts' was defined by another cell
outputs.code:
gs = (explode(coh, "genres").groupby("genres")
      .agg(games=("app_id", "size"), median_reviews=("total_reviews", "median"))
      .reset_index())
gs = gs[gs.games >= 200]
pts = alt.Chart(gs).mark_circle(size=90, color=BLUE, opacity=0.9, stroke="white", strokeWidth=1.5).encode(
    x=alt.X("games:Q", scale=alt.Scale(type="log"), title="Games with this genre (log scale). Further right = more crowded"),
    y=alt.Y("median_reviews:Q", title="Median reviews per game"),
    tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("genres:N", title="Genre"), alt.Tooltip("games:Q", format=","),
             alt.Tooltip("median_reviews:Q", title="Median reviews")],
)
txt = pts.mark_text(align="left", dx=7, dy=-6, fontSize=10, color="#555").encode(text="genres:N")
mo.ui.altair_chart((pts + txt).properties(
    width=700, height=380,
    title=alt.Title("Genres: how crowded each one is vs attention per game",
                    subtitle="Genres with 200+ games. Includes non-game software genres")))

data.text/markdown: Exploration 4. Genres of the top games over time (Q14)

outputs.evalue: The variable 'labels' was defined by another cell
outputs.code:
g2 = games[(games.release_year >= 2010) & (games.release_year <= 2025)].copy()
cut = g2.groupby("release_year").total_reviews.transform(lambda s: s.quantile(0.9))
top = g2[g2.total_reviews >= cut]
n_top = top.groupby("release_year").app_id.nunique()
sh = (explode(top, "genres").groupby(["release_year", "genres"]).app_id.nunique()
      .div(n_top, level="release_year").mul(100).rename("share").reset_index())
main = sh.groupby("genres").share.mean().nlargest(6).index.tolist()
sh = sh[sh.genres.isin(main)]
last = sh[sh.release_year == sh.release_year.max()]
color = alt.Color("genres:N", scale=alt.Scale(domain=main, range=SIX), title="Genre")
line = alt.Chart(sh).mark_line(strokeWidth=2.5).encode(
    x=alt.X("release_year:O", title="Release year", axis=alt.Axis(labelAngle=0)),
    y=alt.Y("share:Q", title="% of that year's top 10% games", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 100])),
    color=color,
    tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("genres:N", title="Genre"), alt.Tooltip("release_year:O", title="Year"),
             alt.Tooltip("share:Q", title="% of top games", format=".1f")],
)
dots = line.mark_circle(size=30)
labels = alt.Chart(last).mark_text(align="left", dx=8, fontSize=11).encode(
    x="release_year:O", y="share:Q", text="genres:N", color=color)
mo.ui.altair_chart((line + dots + labels).properties(
    width=680, height=380,
    title=alt.Title("Which genres the most reviewed games carry, by year",
                    subtitle=["Top 10% of each year's games by reviews.",
                              "A game can have several genres, so the lines overlap and do not add up to 100%."])))

rated = coh[coh.total_reviews >= 10].copy()
rated["band"] = pd.cut(rated.positive_share * 100, bins=range(0, 101, 10), include_lowest=True)
rb = (rated.groupby("band", observed=True)
      .agg(games=("app_id", "size"), median_reviews=("total_reviews", "median")).reset_index())
rb["band"] = [f"{int(max(i.left, 0))} to {int(i.right)}%" for i in rb.band]
order = rb.band.tolist()
enc = dict(x=alt.X("band:N", sort=order, title="Positive review share", axis=alt.Axis(labelAngle=-30)),
           tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("band:N", title="Positive share"), alt.Tooltip("games:Q", format=","),
                    alt.Tooltip("median_reviews:Q", title="Median reviews")])
bar = dict(color=BLUE, cornerRadiusTopLeft=3, cornerRadiusTopRight=3)
a = alt.Chart(rb).mark_bar(**bar).encode(y=alt.Y("games:Q", title="Games"), **enc).properties(
    width=W, height=H, title=alt.Title("Games by positive review share", subtitle="Games with 10+ reviews"))
b = alt.Chart(rb).mark_bar(**bar).encode(y=alt.Y("median_reviews:Q", title="Median reviews per game"), **enc).properties(
    width=W, height=H, title=alt.Title("Median reviews, by positive review share", subtitle="Games with 10+ reviews"))
mo.ui.altair_chart(a | b)

data.text/markdown: Q8 playtime. 80% of games have a median playtime of 0, so playtime cannot be compared fairly. Among games with 1,000+ reviews, 3% are 0.
Exploration 6. Tags (Q11, Q12)

outputs.evalue: The variable 'a' was defined by another cell
outputs.code:
tagged = coh[coh.has_tags]
te = explode(tagged, "tags")
ts = (te.groupby("tags").agg(games=("app_id", "size"), median_reviews=("total_reviews", "median"))
      .reset_index())
ts = ts[ts.games >= 300]
cut1 = tagged.total_reviews.quantile(0.99)
topg = tagged[tagged.total_reviews >= cut1]
in_top = explode(topg, "tags").groupby("tags").app_id.nunique() / len(topg)
in_all = te.groupby("tags").app_id.nunique() / len(tagged)
lift = (in_top / in_all).dropna().rename("lift").reset_index()
lift = lift.merge(ts[["tags", "games"]], on="tags")
lift["pct_top"] = lift.tags.map(in_top) * 100
lift["pct_all"] = lift.tags.map(in_all) * 100
lift = lift.nlargest(15, "lift")

show = set(ts.nlargest(5, "games").tags) | set(ts.nlargest(8, "median_reviews").tags)
pts = alt.Chart(ts).mark_circle(size=40, color=BLUE, opacity=0.7).encode(
    x=alt.X("games:Q", scale=alt.Scale(type="log"), title="Games with this tag (log scale)"),
    y=alt.Y("median_reviews:Q", title="Median reviews per game"),
    tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("tags:N", title="Tag"), alt.Tooltip("games:Q", format=","),
             alt.Tooltip("median_reviews:Q", title="Median reviews")],
)

r = coh.total_reviews.sort_values(ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
n, total = len(r), r.sum()
t1, t10 = int(n * 0.01), int(n * 0.10)
groups = pd.DataFrame({
    "group": ["Top 1% of games", "Next 9%", "Bottom 90%"],
    "games": [t1, t10 - t1, n - t10],
    "share": [r[:t1].sum() / total * 100, r[t1:t10].sum() / total * 100, r[t10:].sum() / total * 100],
})
groups["label"] = groups.share.map(lambda v: f"{v:.0f}%")
order = groups.group.tolist()
a_bars = alt.Chart(groups).mark_bar(cornerRadiusTopRight=3, cornerRadiusBottomRight=3).encode(
    y=alt.Y("group:N", sort=order, title=None),
    x=alt.X("share:Q", title="% of all reviews", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 100])),
    color=alt.Color("group:N", scale=alt.Scale(domain=order, range=[BLUE, "#8fbcef", GRAY]), legend=None),
    tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("group:N", title="Group"), alt.Tooltip("games:Q", format=",", title="Games"),
             alt.Tooltip("share:Q", format=".1f", title="% of all reviews")],
)
a_txt = a_bars.mark_text(align="left", dx=5, fontSize=12, color="#191919").encode(text="label:N", color=alt.value("#191919"))
a = (a_bars + a_txt).properties(width=300, height=180, title=alt.Title(
    "Share of all reviews held by each group of games", subtitle="Games ranked by review count"))

pubs = (explode(coh, "publishers").groupby("publishers").total_reviews.sum()
        .div(total).mul(100).rename("share").nlargest(12).reset_index())
b = alt.Chart(pubs).mark_bar(color=BLUE, cornerRadiusTopRight=3, cornerRadiusBottomRight=3).encode(
    y=alt.Y("publishers:N", sort="-x", title=None),
    x=alt.X("share:Q", title="% of all reviews"),
    tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("publishers:N", title="Publisher"), alt.Tooltip("share:Q", format=".2f", title="% of all reviews")],
).properties(width=300, height=300, title="Publishers with the most total reviews")
mo.ui.altair_chart(a | b)

             alt.Tooltip("games:Q", format=",", title="Games released")],
).properties(width=W, height=H, title="Share of new games with an AI disclosure")

by = (ai.groupby(["release_year", "has_ai_disclosure"])
      .agg(median_reviews=("total_reviews", "median"), games=("app_id", "size")).reset_index())

dom = ["No AI disclosure", "AI disclosure"]

    tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("release_year:O", title="Year"), alt.Tooltip("group:N", title="Group"),
